title: Exercise 4: Sentence Transformation
instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the cue provided so that it has the same meaning as the original sentence.

questions.original_sentence: During his college years at Reed College, Steve Jobs attended calligraphy classes.
questions.correct_answer: While Steve Jobs was attending Reed College, he took calligraphy classes.
acceptable_answers: While Steve Jobs was attending Reed College, he took calligraphy classes.
While Steve Jobs was studying at Reed College, he attended calligraphy classes.
While he was attending Reed College, Steve Jobs took calligraphy classes.
questions.explanation: Chuyển cụm giới từ 'During his college years' thành mệnh đề trạng ngữ thời gian 'While + past continuous'.

questions.original_sentence: Dang Thuy Tram was writing her personal diary when an artillery strike shook the field hospital.
questions.correct_answer: While Dang Thuy Tram was writing her personal diary, an artillery strike shook the field hospital.
acceptable_answers: While Dang Thuy Tram was writing her personal diary, an artillery strike shook the field hospital.
An artillery strike shook the field hospital while Dang Thuy Tram was writing her personal diary.
questions.explanation: Chuyển mệnh đề từ cấu trúc 'was V-ing when...' sang cấu trúc mở đầu bằng 'While + past continuous'.

questions.original_sentence: The film producer was reviewing the animation script, and at the same time his design team was rendering graphics.
questions.correct_answer: While the film producer was reviewing the animation script, his design team was rendering graphics.
acceptable_answers: While the film producer was reviewing the animation script, his design team was rendering graphics.
The film producer was reviewing the animation script while his design team was rendering graphics.
questions.explanation: Sử dụng 'While' để nối hai hành động đang diễn ra song song trong quá khứ.

questions.original_sentence: During the resistance war against foreign invaders, the general devised revolutionary guerrilla tactics.
questions.correct_answer: While he was fighting in the resistance war against foreign invaders, the general devised revolutionary guerrilla tactics.
acceptable_answers: While he was fighting in the resistance war against foreign invaders, the general devised revolutionary guerrilla tactics.
While he was commanding forces in the resistance war against foreign invaders, the general devised revolutionary guerrilla tactics.
questions.explanation: Chuyển cụm thời gian 'During the resistance war' thành mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và động từ 'While he was fighting/leading...'.

questions.original_sentence: The young innovator dropped out of university because of financial hardship.
questions.correct_answer: The young innovator dropped out of university due to financial hardship.
acceptable_answers: The young innovator dropped out of university due to financial hardship.
Due to financial hardship, the young innovator dropped out of university.
questions.explanation: Chuyển mệnh đề chỉ nguyên nhân 'because of' sang 'due to' kết hợp thì Quá khứ đơn 'dropped out'.

questions.original_sentence: At 8 o'clock yesterday evening, the historian was giving a lecture on national heroes.
questions.cue: When the clock struck 8 yesterday evening
questions.correct_answer: When the clock struck 8 yesterday evening, the historian was giving a lecture on national heroes.
acceptable_answers: When the clock struck 8 yesterday evening, the historian was giving a lecture on national heroes.
The historian was giving a lecture on national heroes when the clock struck 8 yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: Sử dụng 'when' đi kèm mệnh đề chỉ mốc thời gian xác định kết hợp với hành động đang diễn tiến.

questions.original_sentence: They heard the announcement of their marriage approval and felt extremely overjoyed.
questions.correct_answer: When they heard the announcement of their marriage approval, they felt on top of the world.
acceptable_answers: When they heard the announcement of their marriage approval, they felt on top of the world.
When they heard the announcement of their marriage approval, they felt over the moon.
They felt on top of the world when they heard the announcement of their marriage approval.
questions.explanation: Dùng liên từ 'When' cho hành động nhận tin xảy ra dứt khoát dẫn tới cảm xúc thăng hoa ('on top of the world').

questions.original_sentence: During the inspection of the theme park, the engineers identified a critical safety flaw.
questions.correct_answer: While the engineers were inspecting the theme park, they identified a critical safety flaw.
acceptable_answers: While the engineers were inspecting the theme park, they identified a critical safety flaw.
The engineers identified a critical safety flaw while they were inspecting the theme park.
questions.explanation: Chuyển đổi danh từ 'the inspection' thành động từ chia thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn 'were inspecting'.

questions.original_sentence: The surgeon was performing a complicated emergency operation when the power supply suddenly failed.
questions.correct_answer: While the surgeon was performing a complicated emergency operation, the power supply suddenly failed.
acceptable_answers: While the surgeon was performing a complicated emergency operation, the power supply suddenly failed.
The power supply suddenly failed while the surgeon was performing a complicated emergency operation.
questions.explanation: Biến đổi câu 'was V-ing when...' sang 'While + was V-ing, past simple'.

questions.original_sentence: He chose to devote to community medical service while he was spending his youth in the highlands.
questions.cue: While he was spending his youth in the highlands
questions.correct_answer: While he was spending his youth in the highlands, he chose to devote to community medical service.
acceptable_answers: While he was spending his youth in the highlands, he chose to devote to community medical service.
He chose to devote to community medical service while he was spending his youth in the highlands.
questions.explanation: Đặt hành động kéo dài 'was spending his youth' vào mệnh đề phụ mở đầu bằng 'While', mệnh đề chính diễn tả quyết định cống hiến 'devote to'.
